mass_scope.included: Every explicit scene.hand component of cad/articulation_drive_v2, including the new root assembly, aggregated by its declared rigid body using exact OCP solid volume, COM and full inertia with assumed material densities.
mass_scope.fixed_base: Palm is fixed to the world. Its CAD mass is reported in the contract but does not move in this hand-only dynamics model.
mass_scope.excluded: Reference arm, installed motor chassis, tendons, pulley/drive routing, wiring and any fasteners or retention parts absent from the hand CAD are excluded.
mass_scope.actuator_location_assumption: All twenty equivalent actuators are fixed off the moving links. No complete installed twenty-motor assembly is represented or approved.
mass_scope.rotor_model: Each compliant cable has the unchanged CP006 scalar equivalent rotor inertia. The compiler's fixed-location 1 g rotor-body dummy is not physical motor chassis mass.
mass_scope.measurement_status: CAD plus assumed density; no measured mass, friction, backlash, damping, motor curve or sensor accuracy. Rigid grouping is not evidence of a physical attachment. Overlapping unfinished exterior parts are counted independently, so this is not an assembled hardware mass prediction.

limitations: The saved source CAD has remaining fabrication blockers; successful model compilation does not imply motion is mechanically possible.
New thumb axes and deep fist ranges are used; old geometry and old mass results are not substituted.
Twenty cable actuators with identity motor-angle mapping are an explicitly ideal-decoupled diagnostic assumption, not a routed transmission or selected design.
Motor, friction, compliance, PWM and controller parameters are uncalibrated comparison assumptions.
Finite-timestep convergence, missing/early events and tracking/hold errors must be reported together.
No camera or perception delay is included. Hardware50/100ms performance remains unverified.
Remaining intersections, disconnected interfaces, retention and strength must be checked separately. Intersecting volumes are counted as separate components, not boolean-unioned physical material.
No collision forces, contacts, cable bend geometry, external loads or wrist/arm motion are modeled. Requested fist poses and ranges are not automatically safe assembled travel.
The identity tendon Jacobian cannot establish packaging or physical removal of upstream motion and torque coupling. Actual transmission and missing assembly mass may change joint loads.
Current-derived torque limits and software PD are uncalibrated assumptions, not validated XL330 behavior.
